high_level_description: This image captures a lively scene on Westminster Bridge in London, with the iconic Big Ben clock tower and the Houses of Parliament in the background. The sky is overcast, suggesting a cloudy day. A large crowd of people is gathered on the bridge and along the sides. Many individuals are waving flags, predominantly the Union Jack (British flag) and the St. George's Cross (English flag). Some people are standing on the bridge, while others are descending stairs leading to the underground area beneath the bridge.
